diagnostics.message: `Input.is_action_just_pressed()` uses the action `dash`, which nothing defines: it is not in project.godot's `[input]` section, it is not one of the engine's built-in `ui_*` actions, and no script calls `InputMap.add_action("dash")`. At runtime Godot prints `ERROR: The InputMap action "dash" doesn't exist` (or silently answers false, depending on the call) and the input never fires. Actions this project defines: attack, down, jump, left, restart, right, sprint, up.
diagnostics.suggested_fix:
or create the action and bind a key (32 = Space; pick your own keycode):
  godot --headless --path /absolute/project --script /absolute/path/to/godot/scripts/core/dispatcher.gd project_batch '{"actions":[{"type":"add_input_action","action_name":"dash"},{"type":"add_input_event","action_name":"dash","event":{"__resource_type":"InputEventKey","properties":{"physical_keycode":32}}}]}'
If the action is instead created at runtime, call `InputMap.add_action("dash")` before the first use, or guard the use with `InputMap.has_action("dash")` — the linter finds either and goes quiet.
